title: Customer support
description: Support queue and response times for agents, and the plumbing behind them: inbound mailbox, notification outbox, LibreDesk webhooks.

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: Deployment environment. Workload selectors are built from it as <env>-ns, <env>-api and so on, matching baseConfig.environment in only-chance-devops. Add prod here when it exists. SQL panels follow the Postgres datasource below, not this variable.

list.name: postgres
list.label: Postgres
list.description: Application database for the selected environment. Add one datasource per environment when prod exists.

panels.title: Support alerts
panels.description: Every Grafana alert rule labelled service=support, firing ones first. Rules bound to a panel on this dashboard also mark that panel.

panels.title: Queue now (independent of the time range)
Active conversations
panels.description: Open, investigating or waiting on the customer; merged conversations excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Active" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL

panels.title: Unassigned
panels.description: Active conversations nobody is assigned to.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Unassigned" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL AND assignee_user_id IS NULL

panels.title: Waiting on us
panels.description: Active, not snoozed, with a customer message no staff reply has answered yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Waiting" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL AND waiting_since IS NOT NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= now())

panels.title: Critical waiting > 1 h
panels.description: Critical or urgent conversations whose oldest unanswered customer message is over an hour old. Alert: Support Critical Conversation Waiting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Critical waiting" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL AND waiting_since IS NOT NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= now()) AND (is_critical OR priority = 'urgent') AND waiting_since < now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Waiting > 24 h
panels.description: Other conversations whose oldest unanswered customer message is over 24 hours old. Alert: Support Conversation Waiting Overdue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Overdue" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL AND waiting_since IS NOT NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= now()) AND NOT (is_critical OR priority = 'urgent') AND waiting_since < now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Longest wait
panels.description: Age of the oldest unanswered customer message across active, not snoozed conversations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(waiting_since)), 0) AS "Longest wait" FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL AND waiting_since IS NOT NULL AND (snoozed_until IS NULL OR snoozed_until <= now())

panels.title: Active by status and priority
panels.description: Current state of the working inbox.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", priority AS "Priority", count(*) AS "Conversations",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE assignee_user_id IS NULL) AS "Unassigned",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE waiting_since IS NOT NULL) AS "Waiting on us",
       min(waiting_since) AS "Oldest waiting"
FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['urgent', 'high', 'normal', 'low'], priority::text), 1

panels.title: Active by category
panels.description: What customers are contacting support about right now.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category AS "Category", count(*) AS "Conversations",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (is_critical OR priority = 'urgent')) AS "Critical or urgent"
FROM support_cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Workload by assignee
panels.description: Active conversations per staff member.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(u.display_name, ''), u.email, 'Unassigned') AS "Assignee", count(*) AS "Active",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.waiting_since IS NOT NULL) AS "Waiting on us",
       min(c.waiting_since) AS "Oldest waiting"
FROM support_cases c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.assignee_user_id
WHERE c.status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'waiting_user') AND c.merged_into_case_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: New conversations by channel
panels.description: Conversations opened per interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), channel AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM support_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resolved and closed
panels.description: Conversations reaching resolved or closed per interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(coalesce(resolved_at, closed_at), $__interval, 0), 'resolved or closed' AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM support_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(coalesce(resolved_at, closed_at))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time to first response
panels.description: Median and 90th percentile time from opening to the first staff reply, by conversation opening time. Internal notes do not count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0),
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM first_response_at - created_at)) AS "p50",
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM first_response_at - created_at)) AS "p90"
FROM support_cases WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Opened
panels.description: Conversations opened in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Opened" FROM support_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL

panels.title: First response within target
panels.description: Share of conversations opened in the range that got a first staff reply within target: 1 h for critical or urgent, 24 h otherwise. Still-unanswered conversations count as misses once past target.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_response_at - created_at <= CASE WHEN (is_critical OR priority = 'urgent') THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '24 hours' END)::float
       / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL OR now() - created_at > CASE WHEN (is_critical OR priority = 'urgent') THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '24 hours' END), 0), 1) AS "Within target"
FROM support_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND merged_into_case_id IS NULL

panels.title: Median first response
panels.description: Median time to first staff reply for conversations opened in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM first_response_at - created_at)) AS "Median"
FROM support_cases WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Median resolution
panels.description: Median time from opening to resolved for conversations resolved in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM resolved_at - created_at)) AS "Median"
FROM support_cases WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at)

panels.title: Notification worker
panels.description: Available replicas of the notification worker, which polls the support mailbox. Alert: Support Notification Worker Down.

panels.title: Mailbox poll failures
panels.description: Failed support mailbox polls in the selected range. Alert: Support Inbound Mailbox Poll Failing.

panels.title: Unseen in mailbox
panels.description: Unseen messages after the cutover watermark at the last poll.

panels.title: Inbound emails stuck
panels.description: Inbound emails that failed, or were received over 15 minutes ago and never processed. Alert: Support Inbound Email Stuck.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Stuck" FROM support_inbound_emails
WHERE (status = 'failed' AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'received' AND received_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')

panels.title: Notifications pending
panels.description: Support notifications (customer emails and operator alerts) waiting in the outbox for over 15 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Pending" FROM support_notification_outbox WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '15 minutes'

panels.title: Webhooks quarantined
panels.description: LibreDesk webhook events quarantined after repeated failures, any age.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Quarantined" FROM support_webhook_inbox WHERE status IN ('failed', 'quarantined')

panels.title: Inbound emails by outcome
panels.description: Inbound support emails processed per interval by status.

panels.title: Inbound email lag p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time from mailbox arrival to a committed outcome.

panels.title: Inbound emails by status
panels.description: Every inbound email by status and reason, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status AS "Status", coalesce(reason, '-') AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Emails",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE auth_flagged) AS "Auth flagged", max(attempt_count) AS "Max attempts", max(received_at) AS "Latest"
FROM support_inbound_emails GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Notification outbox
panels.description: Support notification outbox by channel and status, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT channel AS "Channel", status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Notifications",
       max(attempt_count) AS "Max attempts", min(created_at) AS "Oldest", max(sent_at) AS "Last sent"
FROM support_notification_outbox GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: LibreDesk webhook inbox
panels.description: LibreDesk webhook events by status, current state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_type AS "Event", status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Events",
       max(attempt_count) AS "Max attempts", min(created_at) AS "Oldest"
FROM support_webhook_inbox GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
